Content settings control paragraph lines, list markers, emphasis, tables, and inline heading images

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["content" => ["bullets" => "*", "compactTables" => true, "extractMetadata" => false, "keepInlineImagesIn" => ["h2"], "listIndentWidth" => 4, "stripNewlines" => true, "strongEmSymbol" => "_"]]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->getMarkdown()?->content);
```
